newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open little changed on Wednesday as prices appear stuck in a trading range with little fundamental news to stir interest, dealers said.
Tuesday, October closed 0.02 cent lower at 11.51 cents a lb, having ranged from 11.54 to 11.45 cents. The rest of the board settled 0.01 to 0.04 cent weaker.
An estimated 7,598 lots changed hands on the day.
Near-term technical resistance remained at 11.55 cents followed by the recent high of 11.87 cents, and support at 11.32 cents.

In London, white sugar futures were slightly higher in light trade Wednesday as players awaited the New York market's open. LIFFE October was up 60 cents to $322.90 and the back months stood 30-40 cents higher as of 0838 EDT/1238 GMT.
